description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single hybrid attacks (3.05/3.10 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Twin Element Mode II (Water, Holy)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Altruist Mode I (Arc)] and [Holy/Water Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Altruist Mode I (Arc)
description.text: Holy and Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy and Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Dual Saintly Splash after Holy and Water abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Altruist Mode II (Arc)], removes [Dual Awoken Altruist Mode I (Arc)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Altruist Mode II (Arc)
description.text: Increase the damage/healing cap by 20000, Holy and Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy and Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, restores 2000 HP to all allies after using Holy and Water abilities, grants [Water/Holy Ability Quick Cast 1] to the user after using Holy and Water abilities

description.name: Water/Holy Ability Quick Cast 1
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Water and Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Saintly Splash
description.text: Three single hybrid attacks (2.89/2.72 each), causes [Imperil Holy 10% (5s)] and [Imperil Water 10% (5s)], causes [DEF, RES and MND -50% (8s)] every second use

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Water, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Water/Holy ability

description.name: Holy/Water Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Holy and Water abilities deal 5% more damage
